caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, centered against an off-white or lightly yellowed background. This object appears to be a cylindrical container with a handle on the right side and a perforated domed lid with a small finial on top. The body of the container is smooth and reflective, with subtle shading to indicate its metallic surface. The handle is curved with a decorative flourish at the bottom. The lid is domed and contains multiple small holes, suggesting it may be used to sprinkle powder or another substance. The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink, with fine attention to shifts in light and shadow to create a three-dimensional effect. There is no other object or detail except for the artist's signature, “HOLGER HANSEN,” at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Silver Caster
